messages:
nina: SOS  corporate card declined at check-in in Lisbon so I paid the €245 hotel on my personal card. Also lost a €14 taxi receipt and got charged a separate foreign-transaction fee of $7 on my bank statement. Two teammates Venmo'd me €30 each for a dinner  can I submit one expense and settle, and will the FX fee be reimbursed?
people-ops: Sorry about that. Short answers: (1) reimburse personal hotel if you file a card incident within 48h and attach the docs; (2) missing taxi receipts under local eqv $25 are fine with a bank txn screenshot + note; (3) FX fee reimbursement: we reimburse the posted charge on your statement if the corporate card was unusable and you followed the incident process.
people-ops: Required for hotel reimbursement when corporate card fails:
- itemized hotel folio (pdf/photo)
- card statement line showing the hotel charge and the FX posting
- card-incident ID or ticket number (file at infra/ccards)
- manager sign-off if booking was >$500 or outside policy
people-ops: For Venmo/P2P splits: finance prefers each person submit their own claim. If one person files for the group, include an attendee table and P2P settlement screenshots. Manager sign-off required for any P2P >$50 per person.
finance-bot: :money_with_wings: Note on FX and bank fees: we do not routinely reimburse bank foreign transaction markup (percentage fee) unless the corporate card was declined and you had no alternative. If the bank posts two separate lines (charge + fx fee), include both. Finance will reimburse the net business charge; the fx fee may be reimbursed if incident justified.
raj: Follow-up: I paid a €60 dinner with cash and only have a photo of a single receipt for the table. Can I split on one receipt?
people-ops: Yes, you can submit one receipt and an attendee split table (name -> amount). For cash settlements include bank txn proof or P2P screenshots for any reimbursements.
travel-bot: :airplane: Reminder: retro preapprovals are allowed but slower. File travel preapproval before booking when possible. Link: https://redwood.example/travel-policy
people-ops: @nina if you drop the booking screenshot and the card-incident ID here we'll flag it for expedited review so finance can process next-paycycle. :thumbsup:
